organizations_cgcdetail.a_cgc_is_subject: I CGC ihambisana nemithetho efanayo naleyo yabo bonke abalingani abangasesekelwe; ukuba ngeyomphakathi akunikiwo amalungelo akhethekileyo okulawulwa · Art. III §5.
organizations_cgcdetail.a_common_good_co: Inkampani Yenhlalakahle Yomphakathi iyibhizinisi lomphakathi elisungulwe isishayamthetho ukuze linikeze imikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo endaweni yegunya yalo. Yaqhudelana futhi ilawulwa ngendlela efanayo nezinkampani ezizimele — ngokwehlukana okungaguquki: konke ekwakha kwenzeka kwaba ngokwabo bonke.

Inkampani Yenhlalakahle Yomphakathi iphrophathi yomphakathi egcinwe ngenhlalakahle yomphakathi. Isishayamthetho siyisungula (F-LEG-019), isigaba esiphethe siyigada, futhi iphrophathi yayo yengqondo ihlala iyidomwe lomphakathi (Art. III §5). Ngaphandle kwalokho, ilawulwa ngendlela efanayo nebhizinisi elizimele — futhi isebenzisa isikhalane sokuzimela esifanayo nezinye ibhodi zonke (Art. III §6).

Isilinganiso sibopha kusukela enhlanganweni yokuqala ehlangabezana nezidingo — okokuqala lapho inani labasebenzi abasebenzayo bomqashi lidlula imininingwane emincane ye CLK-13 ({clk13}), umugqa wayo uvela lapha ushintsha ukuba kube → ukulinganisa · isihlalo 1 ngokwakheka_okungasebenzi (composition_valid=false) nokukhethwa kwabasebenzi. Igama elisemthethweni lalokhu ukuzinza ngokuhlanganyela. Isilinganiso esifanayo siyasebenza ezinkampanini ezizimele, eziNkampanini Zenhlalakahle Yomphakathi, kanye neminyango kahulumeni.
